name: Newport
housing: Newport's rentals are mainly terraced and semi-detached houses, with flats in the city centre.

localRules.text: Every private landlord letting a home in Wales must register with Rent Smart Wales, and a landlord who manages the home themselves (or their agent) also needs a licence.
Deposits in Wales must be put in a government-backed tenancy deposit scheme within 30 days of the landlord receiving them.

tenantHelp.name: Shelter Cymru
tenantHelp.what: free housing advice charity in Wales

climate: Photograph any damp or mould and test the heating; older terraced houses in the wet South Wales climate are prone to condensation.
fact: Under the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016, tenants in Newport and the rest of Wales are called contract-holders and have occupation contracts, not tenancies.
